articles.short_snippet: The EU is expected to announce annual import quotas for hybrid and plug-in hybrid cars, extending limits aimed at China to Japan, South Korea, the UK and Turkey, Automotive News Europe reported. articles.title: Five questions on what Jensen Huang's return means for the AI industry
